1. Overview
Investment in fraud analytics focused on earlier detection of account takeover patterns. Treasury extended the
maturity profile of wholesale funding during the period.
The quarter continued the programme of consolidating payment rails onto a single settlement platform. The
markets desk continued to serve corporate clients with hedging and short-term funding products.
Partnership agreements with two payroll providers moved from pilot into general availability. Operating teams
completed the migration of merchant onboarding to the shared identity service.
The board approved the updated capital plan and the dividend policy remained unchanged. The group kept its
funding mix stable, with customer deposits remaining the primary source of liquidity.
